div.div:
How to read
• Front queues — priority: important pages first.
• Back queues — politeness: one host = one queue = at most one request at a time.
• The Frontier shard is picked by hash(host): politeness is enforced locally, no distributed locks.
• Lease with a timeout: if a worker dies, the URL returns to the queue on its own.
